svg.title: V for Vehicle Wrap Design
svg.desc: A 6.5-second looping animation. A bold V reveals a delivery van. A graphic wrap sweeps across the van, then the V moves left and the vehicle wrap design heading and examples for vans, cars and fleets appear.
svg.metadata: 1920 by 1080; 16:9; 6.5-second loop. V form and magenta, black, cream and yellow palette adapted from 22_V_visual_identity.png. Vehicles and brand graphics are illustrative concepts; all graphics, animation and typography are embedded.
